title: is_whole_suite counts tests.py --collect-only, --lf, --deselect and --ignore as a whole-suite run
goal: bl_land.is_whole_suite returns False for a tests.py run that selects or skips tests (--collect-only, --co, --lf, --ff, --deselect, --ignore, --help), so a review's done does not refuse such a check at a loaded host as a whole-suite run. Found by the SP-yriisdti review (S3).

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import bl_land; sys.exit(1 if bl_land.is_whole_suite(['python3', '_tools/tests.py', '--collect-only']) else 0)

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import bl_land as b; sel=["--co","--lf","--ff","--deselect=x","--ignore=y","--help"]; bad=[a for a in sel if b.is_whole_suite(["python3","_tools/tests.py",a])]; whole=b.is_whole_suite(["python3","_tools/tests.py"]); print(bad,whole); sys.exit(0 if not bad and whole else 1)

notes: Planned in SP-uz3rhdlq: repro/checks fail on the base, touches and order set.
